answer_1.quote: We propose a generative model of natural language generation, HRQ-VAE, that induces a syntactic sketch to account for the diversity exhibited by paraphrases... We evaluate on three English paraphrasing datasets which have clear grounding for the meaning of each sentence: Paralex, Quora Question Pairs (QQP), and MSCOCO 2017 (image captions).
answer_1.outputs: generated paraphrase sentences (or captions) conditioned on semantic content and syntactic sketches

answer_2.quote: Our primary metric is iBLEU ... We also report BLEU(outputs, references) as well as Self-BLEU(outputs, inputs). To evaluate the diversity between multiple candidates we report pairwise-BLEU (also referred to as P-BLEU).

answer_4.quote: We elicited judgements from crowdworkers on Amazon Mechanical Turk. They were shown a sentence and two paraphrases, each generated by a different system, and asked to select which one was preferred along three dimensions: the dissimilarity of the paraphrase compared to the original sentence; how well the paraphrase reflected the meaning of the original; and the fluency of the paraphrase.
answer_4.guideline: Workers selected the preferred paraphrase based on three criteria: dissimilarity to the input, meaning preservation, and fluency.
